_text: [fast-paced, energetic storyteller] You carry a lawn chair DOWN to the ocean, while four-thousand people run up the hill. [urgent] Because the moon just switched off, and every phone in town says: giant *wave*. [proud, determined] But you're not leaving Grandma's snack *shack*. [playful] It hasn't sold a hot dog in a month, and tomorrow, Brad the realtor *buys* it. [playful] Brad's on the hill with five-hundred sandbags, two floodlights, and a live stream.
